name: garden-skills
description: ConardLi's open-source Skills collection, featuring web design, knowledge retrieval, image generation, and more.
one_liner: A small set of polished ready-made skills that turn an AI agent into a web designer, a video-presentation maker, or an article beautifier.
buyer: Freelancers and small studios who want to deliver designed decks, articles, and web pages faster without hiring a designer for every job.
business_use_cases: A consultant turns a plain report into a cinematic web presentation to screen-record as a client video.
A newsletter writer runs the 'beautiful article' skill to publish magazine-quality posts from rough drafts.
A small agency uses the web-design skill to spin up landing-page mockups for pitches in minutes.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a done-for-you 'turn your doc into a stunning web presentation' service, priced per deck.
A subscription that keeps a client's brand theme and auto-formats all their content with it.

steal_this: Take just the web-video-presentation skill, offer 'your webinar slides as a recorded cinematic video' to course creators for a flat fee per talk.
